skill_name: Provide three reasons why diversity is important in a workplace.
workflow: Diversity is important in a workplace for a variety of reasons. First, a diverse workplace allows for different perspectives and ideas to be presented and discussed, fostering an innovative workplace and enabling organizations to identify and exploit opportunities more effectively. Second, having a diverse workforce increases organizational performance and creativity, as it allows different viewpoints to be taken into consideration when making decisions.
